concessions.title: Concessionary Rates
concessions.intro: I believe that access to psychological therapy should be as inclusive as possible. Reduced-fee sessions may be available for key workers, veterans and former members of the Armed Forces, students, refugees, older adults, and people on a low income or who are currently unemployed.
eligibleGroups: Veterans & former members of the Armed Forces
People on a low income or currently unemployed
concessions.notes: If you would like to enquire about a concessionary rate, please feel free to get in touch. I will be happy to discuss your circumstances and explain the options available.

insurance.title: Private Health Insurance
insurance.intro: I work with clients who are accessing therapy through the following private health insurance providers:
notes: Depending on the terms of your policy, your insurance may cover some or all of the cost of your therapy sessions. I recommend contacting your insurer before arranging an appointment to confirm your available benefits, the extent of your cover, and whether a referral or prior authorisation is required.
To help arrange your sessions, I will need your insurance membership details and any relevant pre-authorisation code. You will be responsible for any costs that are not covered by your policy.

paymentTerms: Payment is due **48 hours before** each session.
Payment methods include bank transfer, secure card payments via Stripe, or other mutually agreed methods.
cancellationTerms: Please provide **more than 48 hours' notice** for cancellations.
The full session fee may be charged for cancellations made with less than 48 hours' notice.
The cancellation charge reflects the time reserved specifically for you and the inability to offer that appointment to another client.
